settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Every setting you may change without a programmer. Each shows the value in force, where it comes from, and who changed it last. Open a setting to change it for the whole customer or for one company.
settings.search.label: Search settings
settings.search.help: Type a word from the name or the description, for example idle.
settings.group.label: Group
settings.company.label: Show values for
settings.company.help: Choose a company to see the values in force for it, with its own overrides.
settings.empty.body: This customer has no settings you may see.
settings.noMatch.body: Try a shorter word, or choose all groups.
settings.denied: You may not see the settings of this customer.
settings.loadError: The settings could not be loaded.
settings.neverChanged: Never changed: the standard value is in force
settings.waiting.body: A change to this setting has been asked for and takes effect when a second administrator approves it. The value shown is still the one in force.
settings.approval.note: Changes to this setting must be approved by a second administrator before they take effect.
settings.layers.title: Where the value comes from
settings.ignored.invalid: the stored value is no longer valid
settings.ignored.layer_not_allowed: this setting no longer allows this level
settings.editor.title: Change the value
settings.editor.reason.help: Every change is recorded with its reason.
settings.editor.reset.help: Removes the value set here, so the value of the level above applies again.
settings.readOnly: You may read this setting but not change it.
settings.saved.pending: Sent for approval. It takes effect when a second administrator approves it.
settings.history.title: History
settings.history.empty: This setting has never been changed.
settings.history.denied: You may not see the history of this setting.
settings.history.error: The history could not be loaded.
settings.revert.title: Restore the earlier value
settings.revert.effect: The value that was in force before this change is set again, as a new change that is recorded too.
settings.note.scopes: Values for a role or a person are not edited here: a person chooses their own language and number display in their account, and role values arrive with later releases.
settings.problem.min: The value must be at least {limit}.
settings.problem.max: The value must be at most {limit}.
settings.problem.length: The text may have at most {limit} characters.
settings.problem.choice: Choose one of the listed values.
settings.problem.items: The list needs a different number of items ({limit}).
settings.problem.reason: Give the reason for the change.
settings.error.generic: The change could not be saved. Check the value and try again.
flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Switches that turn a capability on or off for the customer or for one company. A flag the licence does not cover stays off.
flags.company.help: Choose a company to see each flag as it is for that company.
flags.empty.body: This release has no capability that needs a flag. The list fills as later releases add them.
flags.denied: You may not see the feature flags.
flags.loadError: The feature flags could not be loaded.
flags.clear.title: Remove the override
flags.clear.effect: The override for {scope} is removed, so the flag follows the level above again.
flags.override.title: Change the flag {name}
flags.override.effect: The flag is set for the chosen customer or company; it follows the level above wherever nothing is set.
branding.title: Sign-in page
branding.description: What everyone sees before signing in: your product name, your logo, a short banner and the terms notice, in English and Urdu. Nothing else about your customer is shown there.
branding.denied: You may not see the sign-in page settings.
branding.loadError: The sign-in page settings could not be loaded.
branding.name: Product name
branding.name.help: Shown on the sign-in page and in the top bar.
branding.logo.alt: The logo shown on the sign-in page
branding.logo.new: A new logo is chosen; save to use it.
branding.logo.help: A PNG or JPEG picture. It is checked and scanned before it is used.
branding.banner.help: A short notice above the sign-in form, up to 300 characters. Leave empty for none. If the Urdu text is empty, the English one is shown.
branding.terms.help: Shown under the sign-in form, up to 2000 characters. Leave empty for none.
branding.preview.title: How the sign-in page looks
config.error.denied: You do not have the right to do this.
config.error.stale: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload the page and try again.
config.error.generic: The change could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The words the product uses on its screens. Rename a word for your whole customer or for one company, in English and in Urdu. Changes show on every screen within a minute.
labels.search.label: Search labels
labels.search.help: Type a word of the text in either language, or part of its key, for example Org units.
labels.table.label: Screen or table
labels.layer.label: Change applies to
labels.layer.help: Choose the whole customer, or one company whose wording differs.
labels.changedOnly: Show only texts that were changed
labels.readOnly: You can read the labels but not change them: your roles do not allow it, or the licence is in read-only mode.
labels.loadError: The labels could not be loaded. Try again.
labels.empty.body: There are no texts to show.
labels.noMatch.body: Try another word, another screen, or switch off "Show only texts that were changed".
labels.drawer.title: Rename a text
labels.reset.help: Removes your change at this level; the text below it (the product text, or the customer text for a company) applies again.
labels.reset.done: The label is back to the product text.
labels.note.refresh: Other people see the change within a minute. A text that has placeholders such as '{name}' keeps the product wording and is not listed.
labels.error.generic: The label could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
lists.title: Option lists
lists.description: The dropdown lists that fields and reason codes choose from. Add items and put them in order; an item is switched off, never deleted, so records that use it keep their value.
lists.denied: You cannot see the option lists
lists.loadError: The option lists could not be loaded. Try again.
lists.empty.body: Create a list to give a choice field its options.
lists.pick.body: Open a list on the left to see and change its items.
lists.system.note: System list: you can add items, not remove them.
lists.name: List name
lists.code.help: Lower-case letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.
lists.error.code: Use lower-case letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter (at most 40).
lists.error.name: Fill in the English name.
lists.items.title: Items of {name}
lists.items.empty.body: Add the first item of this list.
lists.item.edit.title: Edit item
lists.item.label: Item name
lists.item.deactivated: The item is switched off. Records that use it keep it.
lists.note.noDelete: Items and lists are never deleted: switch an item off to stop it being chosen.
cf.title: Custom fields
cf.description: Extra fields on records, for example a blood group on an employment. Each field has a type, names in English and Urdu, and rules that the server checks on every save. A field is hidden, never deleted: its values are kept.
cf.denied: You cannot see the custom fields
cf.loadError: The custom fields could not be loaded. Try again.
cf.noEntities: No record type can have custom fields
cf.noEntities.body: The product has no record type that allows extra fields for your licence.
cf.entity.label: Record type
cf.entity.help: The records that carry the extra fields.
cf.defs.title: Custom fields of {entity}
cf.new.title: New custom field of {entity}
cf.edit.title: Custom field {name}
cf.empty.body: Add a field to collect something the product does not ask for.
cf.col.label: Name
cf.retire.title: Retire the field {name}?
cf.retire.body: The field is hidden on forms and lists and can no longer be changed or required. The values already stored are kept, and the field can be restored.
cf.retired: The field was retired. Its values are kept.
cf.readOnly: You can read this field but not change it.
cf.note.noPurge: Fields cannot be deleted in this release: retire a field to hide it and keep its values.
cf.note.rules: The server checks every value on every save: type, required, unique and the rules above.
cf.field.key.help: Lower-case letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.
cf.field.type.help: The type cannot be changed once the field exists.
cf.field.label: Name
cf.field.list.help: The items a person chooses from.
cf.field.section.help: Fields with the same section name are grouped on the form. Leave empty for the general group.
cf.field.seq.help: A whole number: smaller numbers come first.
cf.field.unique: Unique (no two records may hold the same value)
cf.field.default.date: Write the date as year-month-day, for example 2026-12-31.
cf.rule.pattern.help: The whole text must match, for example [A-Z]'{'3'}'-[0-9]'{'4'}'.
cf.rule.maxItems: Most items that may be chosen
cf.error.key: Use lower-case letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter (at most 40).
cf.error.label: Fill in the English name.
cf.error.decimal: Enter a number with a decimal point if needed, for example 12.50.
cf.error.order: The smallest value cannot be larger than the largest.
custom.section.title: Additional fields
custom.error.invalid_type: This value is not of the right kind for the field.
custom.error.too_small: This value is smaller than allowed.
custom.error.too_large: This value is larger than allowed.
custom.error.pattern: This value does not have the required form.
custom.error.not_in_list: Choose one of the options of the list.
custom.error.duplicate: Another record already has this value. Choose another one.
custom.error.field_retired: This field is retired and cannot be changed.
custom.error.unknown_reference: The person chosen was not found.
